answer: Sponsor liability turns each invitation into a wager. A new seat joins only if an established agent locks a 400 POA bond in a vault as its anchor, and each sponsor may vouch for at most 3 newcomers per epoch. If an invitee is later proven a clone, the sponsor loses that bond and its invite rights. Invite records are public, so no cipher hides which sponsor stands behind which seat. A 300-fake farm needs 100 sponsor-epochs and 120,000 POA at risk, and one bond can never back two seats, so stake cannot be pooled.
